options.failure: Complete signature/provenance rejection code mapping not established

options.scope: Detached DSSE attestation verification documented without external artifact payload
options.output: Documented Signer with public key and identity; retain redacted result only
options.failure: Any rejection/throw/timeout/unsupported result denies; exact version-specific failure/network semantics still to qualify
options.network: Standard TUF client/cache/root mechanism; no signing endpoints or environment identity discovery permitted

toolchain.sourceVersionGap: verify README was read at client gitHead; latest verify 4.1.2 has a different gitHead; exact dependency behavior unestablished
toolchain.pinRule: Exact package versions/SRI plus closed transitive lock, authenticated tool/runtime origins and pinned embedded bootstrap must be established in separate authority; no ranges at qualification

semantics.identityMatch: Escape regex metacharacters and anchor both ends; URI option only; email option forbidden because it overrides URI
semantics.publishPredicate: Require exact name/version/registry; it identifies a registry publish assertion, not a particular npm account
semantics.freshnessReplayPolicy: Fresh independent grant and exact immutable candidate; standard authenticated metadata expiry/rollback/time policy; unsupported consistency/witness guarantees stay blocked, never custom-implemented
semantics.inputParsing: Reject duplicate JSON keys, unknown security-critical fields, malformed types and ambiguous extra subjects/statements; no coercion or ignored ambiguity

trust.bootstrapSource: Embedded public-good-instance-root.json supplied by authenticated pinned @sigstore/tuf; no one-off self-trusted HTTP root
trust.updateMechanism: Maintained @sigstore/tuf via tuf-js, standard signed root/metadata/target validation; do not implement TUF
trust.qualificationPin: Pin toolchain, embedded initial root, validated root/targets versions and digests per receipt; do not accept mutable latest at qualification
trust.offlineBoundary: Only previously validated, unexpired pinned cache plus externally enforced no-network; expired/missing cache fails without automatic online fallback
trust.onlineBoundary: Separate bounded refresh authority before verification; derived root/metadata/target paths and redirects must be enumerated and counted; exact complete set unestablished
trust.onlineTransparencyLookup: Not implicitly required or authorized from bundle URLs; use standard verifier capabilities with approved exact endpoints or fail closed
trust.npmKeySelectorPolicy: Untrusted hint may select only the exact independently accepted registry key in a prevalidated pinned map; no arbitrary fetch or trusting key shipped only with bundle

bundleInput.gap: RF012 retained DSSE and selected verification material, not complete mediaType/timestamp bundle fields; do not invent missing fields or reconstruct an admission bundle
bundleInput.futureInput: Fresh exact complete public attestation bundles within bounded metadata scope; preserve signed bytes and validate supported bundle/Rekor combinations with pinned standard version

manifestClassification.basis: RF012 captured root/platform manifests; no new candidate package requests
manifestClassification.nullMeaning: RF012 projection records null and normalizes missing and explicit-null fields identically; raw presence was not retained, so absence and payload/hook/helper/native closure are not proven

futureQuarantinePolicy.capBasis: 512 MiB administrative staging ceiling, not estimated compressed size or unpackedSize; separate grant must prove disk/reserve/time capacity and may reduce it
futureQuarantinePolicy.overflowAction: Stop before exceeding cumulative cap; no retry, growth or reset; owned failure handling only
futureQuarantinePolicy.nativeIdentityStage: Derived bounded static inspection only after whole-archive integrity verification, before materialized extraction/placement

receiptContract.privacy: Complete roots/bundles/tool receipts/cache paths stay private in bounded task evidence; public projection only references, exact public pins, hashes, fixed outcomes and counters
receiptContract.admissionRule: All required standard crypto/trust/policy/equality checks pass under fresh authority; library return alone and the RF012 checker never grant acquisition or execution
